notes.title: Update v1.06
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aK9A37J-eUU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Updated the operation on Steam Deck.
・Changed how to get language settings when running on Steam Deck.
・Added support for both touch screen and stick input on the menu screen.
・Added game progress indicator.

notes.title: Update v1.05
notes.content:
Changed to start in full screen mode when started in BigPicture mode.
Changed not to use APIs that are not supported by Proton.

notes.title: Update v1.04
notes.content: Touch operation and some problems have been fixed.
